retention._comment: A bucket ending on effective day E becomes rotation-eligible when effective_day >= E + (retention_effective_days - bucket_days + 1) = E + 85. Bucket 1-7 -> day 92; bucket 8-14 -> day 99. Retained detailed history therefore varies from 85 to 91 effective days; it is NOT a guaranteed minimum of 91.

quota._comment: 6 MiB journal + 1 MiB metadata + 1 MiB transaction reserve = 8 MiB. 13 buckets x 448 KiB = 5.69 MiB, inside the journal budget. The reserve is added to every projected append so GC always has room to run.
